before.conditions: Voting gains require sampled paths to differ; greedy decoding yields identical candidates.

changes.rationale: The described method samples multiple reasoning paths before aggregating answers. Identical-greedy-output reasoning requires unchanged inputs and deterministic generation.

changes.rationale: The paper ranks multiple sampled completions. Restrict the dependency to this sampling-based construction; other candidate-generation designs are outside the condition.

fields.conditions: For a fixed model, task set, sampling procedure, and correctness criterion; the preferred temperature depends on the evaluation setting and sample budget.

changes.rationale: Temperature affects candidate diversity and pass-at-k in the reported evaluation; this does not establish a universal monotonic optimum.
